source_manuscript.name: Recognition Kernel Native Completed-Weil Cut-Burden manuscript

source_fourier_convention.formula: f-hat(z)=integral_R f(x) exp(i z x) dx; Plancherel factor 1/(2 pi)

source_translation_convention.formula: T_t h(x)=h(x-t); <f,T_t h> is linear in f

source_boundary_channels.formula: ell_+(f)=f-hat(i/2), ell_-(f)=f-hat(-i/2), B=ell_+ ell_-* + ell_- ell_+*

source_gamma_symbol.formula: G(xi)=Re psi(1/4+i xi/2)-log pi; A_Gamma=(1/(2 pi)) integral G f-hat h-hat*

source_prime_pairing.formula: P_(1/2)=sum Lambda(n)/sqrt(n) [<f,T_log n h>+<f,T_-log n h>]

source_logarithmic_unitary.formula: L F(x)=F(exp x), M F(xi)=widehat(LF)(-xi), L U_t L^-1=T_t, L J_times L^-1=kappa

source_odd_reflection_core.formula: D^-={f in C_c^infty(R):f(-x)=-f(x)} is dense in X_3^- and ell_-(f)=-ell_+(f)

classical_completed_explicit_formula.formula: E_xi(q)=sym sum_rho q-hat((rho-1/2)/i) in the same completed-xi normalization
classical_completed_explicit_formula.source: classical Weil explicit formula as pinned by the source manuscript [Weil 1952; Titchmarsh]

parity_restricted_weil_implication.required: strict positivity of the same classical Weil form on every nonzero odd compactly supported smooth test function implies RH
